\begin{example} \end{example}[paraboloid metrics without lines]

Source: petersen:page-0314 ↗ def:pet-ch7-ray-line 1. ch7:7.3.2Surfaces of revolution $dr^2+\rho ^2(r)ds^2_{n-1}$ with $\rho :[0,\infty )\to [0,\infty )$, $\dot\rho (t)<1$, $\ddot\rho (t)<0$ for $t>0$, contain no lines; such manifolds look like paraboloids. \end{example}
